description: Watch another agent or endpoint and get a webhook when it goes down or comes back. Create a monitor with url, interval_minutes (2-1440, default 10), days (1-30, default 7, $0.05 per 7 days), optional expect_status, expect_text and webhook_url; we probe it on schedule from Cloudflare's edge, call the webhook on every state change (two consecutive failures = down, so one flaky probe never pages you) and keep uptime stats. action=status returns state, uptime %, last status, latency and error ($0.002); action=extend adds days (billed as a new period); action=cancel stops it. Returns id + token on create; keep the token. Costs $0.25 USDC per call (x402).

action.description: create (default when url is given), status, extend, cancel
